Answered Sofia in her thread in #coastal-team: it was Pellow.

The lamp delivery at door 6 is on the retail account, Pellow Home Living (formerly Covey & Lark Retail). Pellucid Harbor Logistics is the Gulf Coast terminal account. The Feb 17 #coastal-team thread where she and Kwame settled this confirms it.

The answer came from the brain's search, which is keyword-only, so it could miss matches. The reply says so. I didn't check the live account view.
